scope: Disposable APFS sparse image and owned child on an ephemeral macOS CI runner; no production VM, volume, service or NATS store
interpretation: Normal unmount refused while the owned child retained a writable Mach memory entry to a file on the mounted image. The child remapped and changed the file. After child exit the same image unmounted normally; a read-only reattach showed the changed prefix. This supports a physical volume-unmount boundary on this owned image, not a guest full-node no-writer hold.
limits: The probe did not inspect the diskutil refusal reason or prove that a live guest system/Data volume can be unmounted. It did not test a UTM boot guard, a clean VM shutdown, production processes, continuous absence of writers, or power-loss durability. The workflow invocation was one-time and removed after recording the result.
